2608.14149.title: QuaSAR: Quantization Compensation via Stable Activation-Aware Rank Truncation
2608.14149.paper_summary: Recent training-free post-training quantization methods restore model accuracy through closed-form residual compensation. To constrain additional model storage overhead, several existing methods gate layer selection by goodness-of-fit, retaining only those layers whose compensation yields a positive residual fit score and discarding the rest. In this paper, we show that, under the low-bit W4A4 setting, this gating mechanism fails to distinguish poorly predictable quantization error from numerical solver failure. Rank-deficient input activations yield severely ill-conditioned or numerically singular Gram matrices, causing the closed-form solver to become unstable and produce spuriously negative fit scores. Consequently, existing goodness-of-fit gates misclassify affected layers as uncompensable and discard them. Many of these discarded layers can nevertheless provide substantial error recovery when their compensation is computed using a numerically stable solver. To address this problem, we propose a parameter-free truncated pseudoinverse solver which removes collapsed directions prior to inversion. On ViT-B with the W4A4 setting, our training-free method achieves 81.42\% top-1 accuracy, outperforming prior post-training methods and fine-tuning-based baselines. Combined with joint low-rank and quantization compression, the proposed method reaches a deployable operating point of 80.26\% accuracy at 54.7 MB, providing a well-balanced trade-off between model size and accuracy.
2608.14149.paper_summary_zh: 最近的無訓練後訓練量化方法透過封閉形式的殘差補償來恢復模型準確性。為了限制額外的模型儲存開銷，幾種現有的方法通過擬合優度來選擇層，僅保留那些補償產生正殘差擬合分數的層，並丟棄其餘層。在本文中，我們顯示，在低位元 W4A4 設定下，這種閘控機制無法區分預測不佳的量化誤差與數值求解器失敗。秩不足的輸入激活產生嚴重病態或數值奇異的 Gram 矩陣，導致封閉形式的求解器變得不穩定並產生虛假的負擬合分數。因此，現有的擬合優度閘控錯誤地將受影響的層分類為不可補償的並將其丟棄。然而，許多這些被丟棄的層在使用數值穩定的求解器計算補償時仍然可以提供可觀的誤差恢復。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種無參數的截斷偽逆求解器，該求解器在反演之前移除崩潰的方向。在 W4A4 設定下的 ViT-B 上，我們的無訓練方法達到了 81.42\% 的 top-1 準確率，超越了先前的後訓練方法和基於微調的基準。結合聯合低秩和量化壓縮，所提出的方法在 54.7 MB 時達到了 80.26\% 的可部署操作點，提供了模型大小與準確性之間的良好平衡。
